meta.phase-name: Schema Import-Export UI, Overlay Warnings, and Generated Output Closure

phase-summary.outcome: Space Explorer test mode now supports the full phase-56 UI loop: schema and canonical-instance import/export, generated-output inspection/export, warnings-only game overlays, and active-pack persistence that matches the now-complete runtime/playability path captured in `56-04`.

file.description: Centralized release-artifact generation so browser test mode and engine release scripts emit the same manifest, schema bundle, report, and language stub outputs.
Bundle build route now returns generated outputs alongside bundle and manifest data for test-mode inspection and export.
Default test-mode payload now exposes the same generated outputs as the on-demand bundle build path.
Header UI now exposes generated-output chips/export actions and warnings-only game overlay diagnostics with one active overlay at a time.
Overlay diagnostics compute category coverage from the real loaded bundle or imported schema documents instead of static fallback assumptions.
Builder state now preserves loaded payload and generated-output data across uploads, rebuilds, and source changes.
Pack source selection now retains schema, canonical-instance, and generated-output data for imported bundles in test mode.
Space Explorer root now wires overlay diagnostics, generated outputs, and active-pack persistence together as the default authoring/test-mode flow.
Runtime closure reference proving the UI layer now sits on top of a completed authored-bundle gameplay path.

commands.command: pnpm --dir docs-site exec vitest run tests/unit/runtime-content-overrides.test.ts tests/unit/overlay-warnings.test.ts tests/unit/content-pack-bundle-build-route.test.ts tests/unit/content-schema-documents.test.ts tests/unit/space-explorer-stat-set-state.test.ts

decision.summary: Space Explorer test mode should surface the same generated outputs that the release/build pipeline emits, rather than a reduced browser-only approximation.
decision.impact: Authoring, inspection, and export all stay aligned with the real codegen/runtime contract.

decision.summary: The first overlay implementation stays warnings-only and lives in the editor/test-mode flow, not as a runtime enforcement gate.
decision.impact: Keeps overlays useful for content authoring without turning them into blocking artifact validation.

next.action: Phase 56 is complete. The next planning discussion should move to phase 58 spatial topology and Unreal placement semantics.
